name: Itemisation
title: Bases, modifier groups, tiers, quality, and loot
summary: 19 consolidates fixed base-specific weights; 0–6 modifiers; random major/minor assignment within 3+3; count-based quality; stage/tier direction; repairable zero-durability items; and monster/NPC loot boundaries.
scenarioNote: Exact base and loot tables remain open.

points.text: Each base/stage has fixed modifier-type weights; character skills/stats cannot change them.
Item Creation skill plus Luck and Perception set modifier-count probability; count determines quality band.
Major/minor assignment is random within caps; reforge preserves total count and group distribution.
Insertion requires a free slot in the extracted modifier's own group.
Ordinary monsters yield ingredients only; NPC deaths leave a randomly selected recoverable half of current equipment.

gaps: Base tables, group probabilities, quality-band nuance, durability, loot edge cases, footprints, compatibility, and carry formula.
